Sharma Mobile & Accessories mein hum phone repair aur screen replacement ka kaam karte hain taaki aapka purana phone fir se theek chal sake. Aap apni shop par visit kar sakte hain aur humare technician se phone dikha sakte hain. Hum subah 10:30 se raat 9:00 baje tak open rehte hain.

Kya naya smartphone ya phone repair karate waqt bill aur warranty milta hai? Sharma Mobile & Accessories par har phone ke sath GST bill aur official brand warranty milti hai taaki aapko baad mein koi pareshani na ho. Aap kisi bhi din subah 10:30 se raat 9:00 baje tak dukan par aa sakte hain.

क्या क्लास 9 और 10 के मैथ के सवाल हल करते वक्त अक्सर कैलकुलेशन में गलती हो जाती है? परीक्षा में बैठने से पहले हर हफ्ते एक खुद का मॉक टेस्ट लें और देखें कि किस चैप्टर में ज्यादा समय लग रहा है। अपनी तैयारी को बेहतर बनाने के लिए आप Boring Road आकर क्लास 9 to 12 maths की डेमो क्लास अटेंड कर सकते हैं। क्लास का समय सोमवार से शनिवार शाम 3 बजे से 8 बजे तक है।

Confused about a tough physics chapter or stuck on a tricky calculus problem before exams? At Vidya Path Classes on Boring Road, our weekly tests and dedicated doubt classes help students clear every concept step by step. When you join for class 9 to 12 maths, you get regular feedback so you know exactly where to improve. Parents and students are welcome to drop by between 3 pm and 8 pm from Monday to Saturday to see how we work.

Gomti Physio & Rehab is a physiotherapy clinic in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, helping office workers, sportspeople, and people recovering from surgery. We provide back and neck pain assessment, sports injury rehabilitation, post-surgery physiotherapy, and posture correction for desk workers. No doctor referral is needed for a first assessment, and each session lasts about forty-five minutes. Get started by visiting the clinic to discuss your needs with our team.

Smile Craft Dental Kothrud ke families aur college students ke liye ek trusted dental clinic hai. Aap yahan routine check-up aur cleaning, root canal treatment, braces aur aligners, aur children's dentistry ke liye aa sakte hain. Humari clinic mein har visit par local anaesthesia ka use hota hai aur dentist treatment shuru karne se pehle har step acche se explain karte hain. Aap free dental check-up camp ke liye bhi visit kar sakte hain jo har mahine ke pehle Sunday ko subah 10 am se dopahar 1 pm tak hota hai (valid till 31 March 2027, fee ₹0). Shuru karne ke liye aap clinic visit kar sakte hain ya details ke liye contact kar sakte hain.

Glow Studio Salon is a unisex beauty salon in Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur, welcoming young professionals and brides-to-be every day. We offer a full range of services including a fresh haircut and styling, hair colour and smoothing, facials and skin care, and expert bridal makeup. Walk-ins are welcome, though appointments get priority so you can plan your visit easily. Drop by to get started with your next look.

Tandoor Junction Vijay Nagar mein ek casual family restaurant hai, jo families aur office groups ke liye perfect hai. Aap yahan aakar garma-garam tandoori starters aur authentic North Indian thali ka maza le sakte hain, jismein Sunday family thali — ₹349 (valid until 2027-06-30): unlimited thali for one bhi available hai. Hum comfortable family dining ke sath-sath party orders bhi accept karte hain, jiske liye 20 ya usse zyada logon ke order par ek din pehle batana zaroori hai. Hum roz subah 11 baje se raat 11 baje tak khule hain. Visit karne ke liye aap seedha aa sakte hain.

IronCore Fitness is a gym in Madhapur built for IT professionals and first-time gym-goers looking for practical ways to stay fit. You get a dedicated strength floor, trainer-led group cardio classes, and structured beginner onboarding to help you start safely. Whether you prefer working out on your own or need personal training to stay consistent, the space is set up to fit your routine. A one-day trial pass is available at the front desk if you want to check the facility before deciding. Drop by during opening hours to get started.

Sharma Mobile & Accessories Laxmi Nagar mein students aur families ke liye ek trusted mobile shop hai. Yahan aapko new smartphones, chargers and accessories, aur exchange of old phones ki suvidha milti hai. Har phone ke sath GST bill aur brand warranty di jaati hai. Agar aapka phone kharab ho gaya hai, toh humare yahan phone repair aur screen replacement bhi kiya jata hai. Visit karne ke liye aap dukaan par direct aa sakte hain.

विद्या पथ क्लासेस बोरिंग रोड, पटना के स्कूल के बच्चों और उनके पेरेंट्स के लिए कोचिंग इंस्टिट्यूट है। यहाँ क्लास 9 से 12 तक के लिए मैथ्स और साइंस की कोचिंग और जेईई फाउंडेशन बैच चलाया जाता है। साथ ही बच्चों की तैयारी मजबूत करने के लिए वीकेंड टेस्ट और डाउट क्लासेस होती हैं और पेरेंट्स-टीचर मीटिंग भी रखी जाती है। हम चाहते हैं कि हर बच्चा अपनी पढ़ाई को ठीक से समझे। आप पहली क्लास में आकर डेमो ले सकते हैं और हमारी पढ़ाई का तरीका देख सकते हैं। क्लास शुरू करने के लिए हमसे संपर्क करें।
As for the expertise, my back pain is better, and regarding the explanation, the therapist explained everything.
As for the doctor behaviour, it was my son's first dental visit and the doctor was very gentle with him. The cleanliness was good too.
The bridal trial was relaxed, and the makeup lasted all day.

सही दाम मिले और अच्छी सलाह भी बहुत अच्छी लगी।
हर हफ्ते टेस्ट होता है और शिक्षक अच्छे हैं।
